1
Ism e Mohammad Ko Chomte Hain Lyrics
Nigahon Ko Kar Kar Ke Khum Chomtay Hain.
Jo Ism-e-Muhammad Ko Hum Chomtay Hain.
Muhammad Ki Zulfoon Ko Imran Maula.
Samajh Ke Khuda Ki Qasam Chomtay Hain.
Jo Akbar Ne Naat-e-Muhammad Sunai.
Tu Dawood Unn Ke Qadam Chomtay Hain.
Mere Hath Janat Bananey Lagay Hain.
Keh Behlool Mera Qalam Chomtay Hain.
Muhammad Bashar Hain Bashar Ba Ko Bholay.
So Shar Kar Ke Ranj-o-Alam Chomtay Hain.
Aray Hum Tu Dil Ki Nigahon Se Jali.
Jabeeno Se Sare Haram Chomtay Hain.
Jo Jali Ke Choney Ko Kehte Hain Bidat.
Woh Turbat Se Hasil Raqam Chomtay Hain.
Faqat Naat Likha Tha Kagaz Pe Main Ne.
Tu Hamd-o-Qaseeda Qalam Chomtay Hain.
Ali Ki Bulandi Ka Hai Raaz Yeh Keh.
Habib-e-Khuda Ke Qadam Chomtay Hain.
Muhammad Ke Betay Ke Zawwar Hain Jo.
Woh Marne Se Pehle Iram Chomtay Hain.
Hoye Mas Mere Hath Naat-e-Nabi Se.
Barey Mohtaram Mohtaram Chomtay Hain.
Khushi Se Muhammad Tu Beti Ki Turbat.
Zara Kar Ke Aankhon Ko Nam Chomtay Hain.
Madine Se Sadiq Wafa Karbala Hai.
Khushi Dhondtay Hain Keh Gham Chomtay Hain.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 26 Urdu verses in the selected lyric and verified that they align line by line with the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Updated the title and right-to-left direction, and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag. Only the selected file changed.

I rendered the ambiguous readings “Ba Ko” as `با کو` and “Sare Haram” as `سرِ حرم`.
